## Three Minute Thesis

### When DNA Becomes the Sensor: Building Smart Nanopores from Life’s Own Code

My presentation introduces DNA origami hybrid nanopores to a general audience. It received a shared **People’s Choice Award** at SMU’s **Fall 2025 Three Minute Thesis competition**.
